info.title: AgentPlaza hub API
info.description: The hub's HTTP API (apid). Generated from its router by `apid openapi`: do not edit by hand. A request from the hub's own machine (a loopback peer whose Host names this machine, and not a cross-origin browser request) is the owner's without a token: an operation's security lists the empty requirement `{}` for that.
